target.name: Marcus
target.detail: following the blue dot, not the road

setup: Woman walking with the phone held out flat, following the blue dot, headphones in, trusting the whole city to move around her.
on_success: On the shoulder, off the wrist, gone down the side road before the map even reroutes.
on_fail: She's got a wrist strap. You didn't clock the wrist strap. Now you're both attached to the same phone and only one of you is embarrassed.
on_crit: Newest model, case still shiny. There's a second phone in her hand too. Some people.

target.name: Priya
target.detail: on a video call to family abroad

setup: Phone propped on the café window ledge, screen out, a video call going — someone's mum, a whole kitchen, half a world away.
on_success: You lift it mid-sentence. Somewhere a kitchen full of people is now looking at your trainers, briefly.
on_fail: She's faster than the call. Grabs it back and doesn't even pause the conversation. 'One sec, Ma.'
on_crit: Phone and the little battery pack it's plugged into. The call keeps going in your pocket. You hang up. Feels rude not to.

target.detail: phone on the handlebars at the lights

setup: Cyclist stopped at the red, phone clipped to the bars, thumbing a message, front foot down, not going anywhere for nine seconds.
on_success: Green light, empty mount. He pedals off owing an explanation to whoever he was texting.
on_fail: He's off the bike quicker than you'd think a man in cleats can move. Clip-clopping after you, furious.
on_crit: Whole mount comes off in your hand. Phone's still recording a ride. Later there's forty minutes of tarmac and swearing.

target.detail: balanced while she does the straps

setup: Mum balancing the phone on the pram hood while she wrestles a wriggling kid into the straps. Both hands full.
on_success: Gone off the hood while she's mid-negotiation with a two-year-old. She won't miss it for a street.
on_fail: The kid points and yells. She's up and shouting and a bloke across the road is already jogging over.
on_crit: Phone's unlocked, a photo of the kid on the screen. You don't look at it again. You just don't.

target.detail: leaning out to look for the train

setup: Bloke on the platform leaning out over the yellow line, phone in the outside hand, watching for the train that's two minutes out.
on_success: You take it as the train noise builds. He's still leaning out looking for a train, phoneless, none the wiser.
on_fail: He pulls back off the line fast and clocks you clocking him. Doors open. Neither of you gets on.
on_crit: Top-end phone, and it's logged into everything. You wipe it and move it on the same night. No souvenirs.

target.detail: phone held out at arm's length

setup: Tourist doing the big pose in front of nothing special, phone out at the end of a stick, back to the whole street.
on_success: You take the phone, leave the stick. Balance restored to the universe.
on_fail: The stick swings round like a weapon and there's suddenly a very loud group of them.
on_crit: Phone off the mount and it's still on burst mode. Somewhere there's twelve blurry photos of you leaving.

target.name: Tone
target.detail: on his break, moaning about the rota

setup: Bloke in a doorway on his break, fag in one hand, phone in the other, deep into moaning about the rota.
on_success: Off the palm and gone. He carries on the sentence for a second before the sentence loses its point.
on_fail: He's got quick reflexes for a man on a fag break and a temper to match. Chef's whites and all.
on_crit: Phone still warm, still ranting into a group chat. He was owed a raise. You are not the raise.

target.detail: one hand on the lead, one on the phone

setup: Dog walker with the lead in one hand, phone in the other, a big soft Labrador more interested in you than in guarding anything.
on_success: The dog wags at you the whole time. Terrible security. Lovely dog.
on_fail: The dog's fine. The owner is not, and can run in wellies, which shouldn't be allowed.
on_crit: Phone's lock screen is the same Labrador. You feel, briefly, like you've robbed the dog.

target.detail: scrolling, not moving up the queue

setup: Someone in the chicken shop queue, thumb going, not noticing the queue's moved up two people without them.
on_success: You move up the queue as they look down at it. By the till, it's yours and you're gone.
on_fail: The bloke behind them saw the whole thing and has decided today's the day he's a hero.
on_crit: Phone's mid-order on a delivery app. Somewhere, food arrives at a door for a person who no longer has a phone.

target.detail: tethered to a wall socket, guard down

setup: Phone plugged into one of those station wall sockets, owner sat beside it reading a proper paper book, fully off guard.
on_success: You pull it off the lead clean. They turn a page. By the time they look up, there's just a dangling cable.
on_fail: The book was a decoy. They were watching the reflection in the window the whole time. Clever.
on_crit: Phone and the charger both. Fast charger, worth having on its own. Two-for-one and a long walk to the next platform.
